tools.name: scale_recipe
tools.description: Scale every ingredient of a recipe from one serving count to another, with friendly kitchen measures and items without a quantity passed through.

tools.name: convert_units
tools.description: Convert a cooking amount between units: same-dimension conversions are exact; cups to grams and similar need a known ingredient density.

tools.name: merge_shopping_list
tools.description: Merge several shopping lists into one: quantities of the same item are summed in a common unit and shown in the friendliest kitchen unit; items without a quantity are collected as notes.

tools.name: cost_per_serving
tools.description: Total the cost of the ingredients in a recipe and divide it by the servings to get cost per serving, also shown for 10 servings.
